titolo: OpenAI launches Pando, a Git‑compatible backend for large‑scale Codex development
descr: OpenAI released Pando, a Git‑compatible system built to handle the massive development workflows driven by Codex.
paragrafi: OpenAI announced a new backend called Pando that works with Git protocols.
Pando is designed to support the scale of development projects that Codex enables.
The system aims to manage large codebases and many contributors without breaking Git compatibility.
OpenAI says the backend will help teams handle the increased volume of changes generated by AI‑assisted coding.
perche: Developers using AI‑powered coding tools will benefit from a backend that can keep up with rapid, large‑scale changes. For users of free or local models, the move highlights the infrastructure demands of extensive AI‑driven development, underscoring why open‑source alternatives may need similar scaling solutions.
